utv.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Philadelphia
utv.uk.description: James's American adventure continues with a visit to Philadelphia - The City of Brotherly Love is the perfect backdrop for his foodie adventure, with Reading Terminal Market providing all manner of ingredients for both of his cooks. The market even has its own kitchen, so it's not a problem if James forgets an ingredient - James then ditches the car to take a tour of the city's famous murals, but vehicles with more power await... Philadelphia is home to one of the most impressive car collections in the world - as a result, James gets a spin in a very special car. Philadelphia is also host to an upcoming movement of vegan eating - Charlie Was A Sinner is at the forefront of this, and James's visit allows us to see what makes a restaurant like this so popular. (Documentary) - 2018

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end. Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home, marking another change among the farm's animals. Then it is all hands on deck for the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz and Kelvin pack enough farm produce to fill a huge marquee, along with the butcher's fridge to keep their Milo sausages chilled. With everything ready, they step into the world of trading and face a busy day behind the counter. (Reality) - 2023

utv.uk.title: Millionaire Hot Seat - Tue 6th Jan 7.30pm
utv.uk.description: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash. (Reality) - 2026

utv.uk.title: Long Lost Family - Sunday 22 Mar
utv.uk.description: This episode features two women searching for siblings - the first has been hoping to find her brother ever since learning of the enormous burden of grief her mother carried after giving him up. Tracey Boyle had children of her own before she learned of her brother's existence - after a stay in hospital following a breakdown, her mother finally confided in Tracey the enormous weight of grief she carried ever since her first-born son was prised from her hands at the age of 16 and placed for adoption. Tracey is determined to find him and let him know he was wanted - in our second story, a woman who had a strange sense she had a sister out there during her own adoption finally gets confirmation of her intuition. Liz Allward was adopted as a baby, but she always had an uncanny feeling that she had a biological sister somewhere out there and has longed to meet her from the moment she found out she was right. (Documentary, Family) - 2011

utv.uk.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught On Camera
utv.uk.description: Unbelievable, shocking and uplifting viral videos filmed by people across the world and narrated by award-winning actor Roger Allam. Go behind the lens to hear the firsthand accounts of these once in a lifetime experiences. Starting in Kentucky, we meet a truck driver who dices with death after crashing off a bridge. We also meet the man who emerged from the LA fires a hero. Heading to Canada, we hear one climber's story from a trip that was almost his last. In the state of Illinois, a volunteer firefighter has a very lucky escape from a burning building. Meanwhile, in the rolling Yorkshire Dales, a caver has an unusual animal encounter 30 metres underground, while a railway worker comes face-to-face with an equally surprising sight on the streets of Birmingham. All stories you wouldn't believe if they weren't caught on camera. (Documentary) - 2016

bbconemidlands.uk.title: War Horse
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Steven Spielberg's adaptation of Michael Morpurgo's First World War drama, starring Emily Watson, David Thewlis and Jeremy Irvine. Dartmoor, 1914: when Ted Narracott buys a thoroughbred horse for his farm, his son Albert soon bonds with the animal who he names Joey. However, when the harvest fails and war is declared on Germany, Ted is forced to sell Joey to the British Army. Albert enlists but can he and Joey survive the horrors of the Front to be reunited.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Planet Earth: A Tale of Three Bears
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E1 Julia Bradbury and wildlife expert Lynn Rogers explore the Northwoods of Minnesota, following three black bear cubs and learning the dangers they face in the wild. The infant creatures are desirable prey for roaming coyotes and wolves, and combined with the threat posed by hunters and changeable weather conditions, their survival depends entirely on how well they learn skills from their mother.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Blue Planet III
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E1 Tropical Seas The third instalment of the nature documentary, revealing wonders of the oceans using developments in camera technology and scientific discovery. In the tropical seas, year-round sunshine has created the perfect conditions for the ocean's richest habitats to flourish, but survival takes remarkable and surprising ingenuity. Narrated by David Attenborough.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Countryfile
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 Co Antrim Dairy Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across Co Antrim, one of Northern Ireland's most productive dairy regions, are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future. Adam also introduces this year's BBC Food and Farming Awards Countryfile Young Countryside Champion nominees.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Reluctant Vampire
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E6 The day of Val's initiation ceremony approaches, and he still has no idea how he'll pass the vampire test. When his final plan doesn't work out, he realises he can no longer live a double life and is faced with the ultimate dilemma. Should he come clean and risk everything for the chance of a human life or sacrifice who he really is for the sake of his family.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E14 Week 7 2026 Results Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe present as the two lowest-scoring couples go head to head in the dance-off. Plus, the professionals show the celebrities how it's done with a group routine.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Blue Planet III
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E2 Open Ocean Wildlife in the open oceans far beyond the sight of land, from giant blue whales to tiny drifting crabs. The programme explores how the sea is shaped by powerful currents that flow across the globe like invisible rivers. Among the areas visited are the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt, one of the largest floating ecosystems on the planet.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: This City Is Ours
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E5 Desperate to recover their losses, the Phelans strike a deal with Ozzie Thompson. At Jamie and Melissa's engagement party, Michael and Diana attempt to broker peace with the family. Meanwhile, Freddie spirals further out of Michael's control.

bbconemidlands.uk.description: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Crystal Palace v Liverpool at Selhurst Park and Manchester United v Aston Villa at Villa Park. Palace took the honours against the Reds in three of their meetings with them last term, but Andoni Iraola's men had proved difficult to beat on their travels so far in the current campaign. Elsewhere, the Villans will have been looking to inflict more misery upon a struggling United side. Plus, Brighton & Hove Albion v Brentford, Ipswich Town v Bournemouth and Sunderland v Chelsea.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v Australia
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E24 England v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' opening match in the Northern Hemisphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England bounced back from a defeat at the hands of South Africa in the Southern Series with victories over Fiji and Argentina. Australia comfortably claimed their first win of the series against Italy after losses to Ireland and France. With analysis from Ugo Monye and George Gregan, pitchside reports by Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Unbelievable Moments Caught on Camera
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E4 A Kentucky truck driver dices with death after crashing off a bridge, while there is footage of a man who emerged from the Los Angeles fires a hero and a Canadian climber recalls a trip that was almost his last. In Illinois, a volunteer firefighter has a lucky escape from a burning building, while in the Yorkshire Dales, a caver has an unusual animal encounter 30 metres underground.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Assembly
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E4 Anna Maxwell Martin Actress Anna Maxwell Martin faces a panel of autistic, neurodivergent and learning-disabled interviewers. As the questions come thick and fast, she opens up about grief, motherhood and how her children coped after the death of their father, and also reflects on bullying in the industry, sensory issues and the acting skills she's used to get herself out of trouble.

itvlondon.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvlondon.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm this Remembrance Sunday are racing hero Billy Monger and Gavin and Stacey's Laura Aikman. Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic. Then, original emergency service vehicles used to help wounded soldiers during the war years make their way onto the show. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvlondon.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvlondon.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvlondon.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars

They'll have to produce stand-out dishes from a recipe they've never seen before in just 30 minutes. The two stars who impress the most go straight through to the quarter-finals, and the losing stars will have to impress the world-class chefs and cook again in the cook-off - where one will leave the competition. (Cookery, Entertainment, Reality) - 2026

itvlondon.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Australia

amc.us.description: A goofy detective specializing in animals goes in search of the missing mascot of the Miami Dolphins. - 1994

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
amc.us.description: A sacred white bat's disappearance begets bloodshed between African tribes and puts the goofy pet sleuth (Jim Carrey) on the case. - 1995

amc.us.title: We Are Marshall
amc.us.description: Jack Lengyel, the new coach at West Virginia's Marshall University, vows to rebuild the school's football program after a plane crash claims the lives of 75 players, staff and fans. - 2006

amc.us.title: The Replacements
amc.us.description: A football coach and his team's owner recruit a ragtag band of has-beens and wannabes after failed negotiations lead to a strike. - 2000

amc.us.title: John Wick
amc.us.description: New York City becomes the bullet-riddled playground of a former assassin (Keanu Reeves) as he hunts down the Russian mobsters who destroyed everything he held dear. - 2014

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
amc.us.description: Legendary hit man John Wick comes out of retirement when a former associate plots to seize control of an international assassins' guild. Bound by a blood oath to help him, Wick travels to Rome to square off against the world's deadliest killers. - 2017

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
amc.us.description: Stripped of the High Table's protective services, legendary hit man John Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as the world's most ruthless killers try to collect the $14 million bounty on his head. - 2019

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
amc.us.description: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin. (Action) - 2023

amc.us.title: The Replacements
amc.us.description: It's late in the season; the playoffs are fast approaching; and the Washington Sentinels have just gone on strike. Scrambling for a solution, the Sentinels' owner Edward O'Neil hatches a plan to bring in legendary coach Jimmy McGinty to recruit a team of replacement players in exactly one week. For fans and owners alike, the strike is a disaster. But for Shane Falco and a mismatched crew of outsiders, it is the second chance they've waited their whole lives for. (Comedy) - 2000

amc.us.title: Rudy
amc.us.description: Rudy Ruettiger (Sean Astin) wants to play football at the University of Notre Dame, but has neither the money for tuition nor the grades to qualify for a scholarship. Rudy redoubles his efforts to get out of the steel mill where his father works when his best friend (Christopher Reed) dies in an accident there. Overcoming his dyslexia thanks to his friend and tutor, D-Bob (Jon Favreau), Rudy gains admission to Notre Dame and begins to fight his way onto the school's fabled football team. (Drama) - 1993

amc.us.title: Paid Programming
amc.us.description: Paid programming. (Consumer, Shopping, Variety)

amc.us.title: What About Bob?
amc.us.description: Before going on vacation, self-involved psychiatrist Dr. Leo Marvin (Richard Dreyfuss) has the misfortune of taking on a new patient: Bob Wiley (Bill Murray). An exemplar of neediness and a compendium of phobias, Bob follows Marvin to his family's country house. Dr. Marvin tries to get him to leave; the trouble is, everyone love Bob. As his oblivious patient makes himself at home, Dr. Marvin loses his professional composure and, before long, may be ready for the loony bin himself. (Drama) - 1991

amc.us.title: Captain Phillips
amc.us.description: In April 2009, the U.S. container ship Maersk Alabama sails toward its destination on a day that seems like any other. Suddenly, Somali pirates race toward the vessel, climb aboard and take everyone hostage. The captain of the ship, Richard Phillips, looks to protect his crew from the hostile invaders, and their leader, Muse. The pirates are after millions of dollars, and Phillips must use his wits to make sure everyone survives and returns home safely. (Docudrama, Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Biography) - 2013

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
amc.us.description: After gunning down a member of the High Table -- the shadowy international assassin's guild -- legendary hit man John Wick finds himself stripped of the organization's protective services. Now stuck with a $14 million bounty on his head, Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as he becomes the target of the world's most ruthless killers. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
amc.us.description: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin. (Action) - 2023

amc.us.title: Knives Out
amc.us.description: The circumstances surrounding the death of crime novelist Harlan Thrombey are mysterious, but there's one thing that renowned Detective Benoit Blanc knows for sure -- everyone in the wildly dysfunctional Thrombey family is a suspect. Now, Blanc must sift through a web of lies and red herrings to uncover the truth. (Mystery, Crime drama, Comedy, Thriller) - 2019

amc.us.title: Cast Away
amc.us.description: Obsessively punctual FedEx executive Chuck Noland (Tom Hanks) is en route to an assignment in Malaysia when his plane crashes over the Pacific Ocean during a storm. The sole survivor of the flight, Chuck washes ashore on a deserted island. When his efforts to sail away and contact help fail, Chuck learns how to survive on the island, where he remains for years, accompanied by only his handmade volleyball friend, Wilson. Will Chuck ever return to civilization and reunite with his loved ones? (Drama, Adventure, Romance) - 2000

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel has invited Baby to sleep over. What happens when Squirrel wants to go to sleep but Baby still wants to have fun? S1 Ep26

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby has picked beautiful flowers for sheep but is having trouble flying while holding the flowers. Luckily, he has her good friends. S1 Ep6

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby and Sheep want to go for a swim in the lake but Sheep can't find her orange bathing suit. Join Baby & Sheep as they search for everything orange. S1 Ep20

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam find a mouse in their tree house. When he disappears, they decide to play mouse race!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam have toy robots! When their batteries run out Billy and Bambam use cardboard boxes to become robots themselves!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam make their own xylophone from colorful glasses. Come hear the music they make.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become country singers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles drums and a guitar! S1 Ep25

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become tailors! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a sewing machine!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become chefs! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a cookbook! S1 Ep27

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a wonderful woodpecker! Come along and see woodpecker as he cracks pecan nuts!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Good morning! Mr. Snail meets a rooster who lost his voice! How will he wake up all the animals?

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: Captain Katie, Jon Jon and Beth go in search of the pirate treasure.

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: Captain Katie, Jon Jon and Beth go in search of the pirate treasure.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a field mouse in a wheat field! Mouse prepares wheat grain for his visiting cousin, the city mouse.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a song bird! See what happens when poisonous rattle snakes arrive! Everyone is in a different rhythm!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: The girls need to cross a wide river in order to get to the treasure. Come help them find the right path to cross

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit the magical colorful forest.

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu climb tall pyramids and play ancient ball games in the jungle.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Elephant and Baby Butterfly go on an expedition under the sea in a yellow submarine.

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: It's Harley's birthday and Perry is throwing her a surprise party! Harley keeps on showing up while Perry is trying to decorate.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix and Leo are fascinated by ants! How can they carry so much when they are so small? Join Pix and Leo as they follow the ants.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli bumps into Shere Khan while wandering alone in the jungle. Shere Khan tries to intimidate him but all his tactics don't seem to work.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: The four friends on the island are unpleasantly surprised when two octopuses begin littering the island. S1 Ep5

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: When Bucky hears about the exciting travels of a bird who is migrating south for the winter, he doesn't want to miss out on all the excitement.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Spain. The King loves travelling in his royal coach but it is always hot inside!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Italy. Maria, the King's daughter doesn't want to eat! S1 Ep13

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the animal friends as they visit Australia. John blows into a hollow branch so that his friends can hear him after he gets stuck on a tree! S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become explorers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a boat! Sail the seas and discover the best treasure. S1 Ep22

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become mail carriers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a mail bag! Turtle wants to receive mail!

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? An alarm clock to help wake up in the morning!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam find a hungry mouse while enjoying thier picnic. They give it some bread and cheese and then they all play hide and seek!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam learn how to mix colors in order to make new ones. When they finish painting, they use the colorful bottles as bowling pins.

babytv.uk.title: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue
babytv.uk.description: Laz gets stuck in a hole in the fence after trying to save Hop's hat. Hop and Butterson go on a wild ride in a paper airplane to try and save her.

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: It's Dolly's birthday and she's celebrating with her friends. When Snail gives her a birthday cake tied to a bouquet of flowers, the cake flies off?

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Needles tries to paint his friend Florence the flower. When he uses the wrong colors, Florence gets upset.

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops Song Series
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops celebrate their differences and the colorful world they live in. Come join them!

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops Song Series
babytv.uk.description: Do you sometimes feel like doing something you're not allowed to do? So do the Lollipops!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Wag your tail and put up your paws - come dance like a cat. Don't forget "Meow"!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Come and join the monkey party! Beat your chest like a drum and say oo-oo-oo!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Have you ever danced in the snow with a bunny? It's fun! Come wiggle your nose and wag your tail!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Did you know seals love to dance? Now you can dance along! Don't forget to raise your flippers, jump, turn and clap!

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe and Baby want to sing the friendship song together. Pretty soon the entire bunch are singing and playing to the catchy tune. S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby wants to play with his friends but they are all busy. Squirrel is working in his garden, Giraffe is cleaning her roof.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Elephant and Baby have come over to Rabbit's house to have some of his delicious carrot cake. S1 Ep10

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam throw a birthday party for Dolly's birthday. They have everything you need - balloons, party hats, party blowers and cake of course!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam find a hungry mouse while enjoying thier picnic. They give it some bread and cheese and then they all play hide and seek!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam learn how to mix colors in order to make new ones. When they finish painting, they use the colorful bottles as bowling pins.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become explorers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a boat! Sail the seas and discover the best treasure. S1 Ep22

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become mail carriers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a mail bag! Turtle wants to receive mail!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become pilots! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a plane! Fly high in the sky! S1 Ep30

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail has lost his way in the forest and meets a sloth! Join Mr. Snail as he sees sloth hanging from a tree and eating bananas!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a flipped over turtle on the beach! Turtle's mum and brothers are in the sea!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: Captain Katie, Jon Jon and Beth go in search of the pirate treasure.

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: Come join Captain Katie, Jon Jon and Beth as they bravely surmount obstacles and solve puzzles in order to get to the pirate treasure.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail sets out on an adventure to the puddle! Join him as he meets a bird and discovers the taste of puddle water!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail discovers a nest on a porch! Join him as he sees a little chick hatch from its egg!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: On their way to finding the treasure, the Lollipops run into a friendly whale squirting water

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit the colorful world of the Vikings.

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit the Viking world in the winter time!

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry take care of a tortoise egg until it hatches. The bring it clothes, toys, dolls and even a trampoline! Will it hatch?

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: It's nighttime and the cricket band is playing music! Pix is having trouble sleeping. Will Pix be able to find who is making all that noise?

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli and Leela find the perfect muddy mud slide but they can't persuade Gray to join in the fun. Will he be able to overcome his fear?

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: It's Christmas on the island, and Coco is preparing for his special carol singing. But every time Coco starts singing, a guest arrives.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: It's a quiet day on the island when suddenly the wind brings a duck boat, especially for Bucky - the brave captain Bucky. S1 Ep5

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Toto, Robbie and Dolly are all busy baking a cake! After pouring all the ingredients in the pan Robbie uses his hand as a whip to whip them all up.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Shusha eats, talks and walks very fast! Join Shusha as she moves fast and dances Samba on the beach to the beat of the amazing drum! S1 Ep11

bbcfour.uk.title: The Pembrokeshire Coast: A Wild Year
bbcfour.uk.description: 1/3. A look at Pembrokeshire's wild and rugged coast, where life is defined by the rhythm of the seasons and the power of the sea. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: Bolsover Castle with Lucy...
bbcfour.uk.description: ...Worsley: Secret Knowledge. Lucy Worsley tells the story of Bolsover Castle in Derbyshire. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: War Grave
bbcfour.uk.description: Moving stories of loss and remembrance, told by the loved ones of those killed in action. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: Playing the Dane
bbcfour.uk.description: Stars of theatre, television and film, including Jeremy Brett, Richard Briers, Ian McKellen and Christopher Walken, describe the challenge of playing Shakespeare's Hamlet.

bbcfour.uk.title: Steven Berkoff Remembers... Hamlet at Elsinore
bbcfour.uk.description: Steven Berkoff remembers the 1964 BBC production Hamlet at Elsinore.

bbcfour.uk.title: Hamlet at Elsinore
bbcfour.uk.description: 1964 production of Shakespeare's famous play. Filmed in Elsinore, Denmark.

bbcfour.uk.title: Count Magnus: A Ghost Story for Christmas
bbcfour.uk.description: The inquisitive Mr Wraxhall discovers that a long-dead Swedish nobleman does not lie easy in his tomb. Contains some scenes which some viewers may find upsetting. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: The Mezzotint: A Ghost Story for Christmas
bbcfour.uk.description: In 1923, Edward Williams receives an engraving, but the picture is not what it seems. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: Martin's Close: A Ghost Story for Christmas
bbcfour.uk.description: 1684. John Martin is on trial for his life, but this is not a cut-and-dried murder case. Contains some violent scenes. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: The Dead Room: A Ghost Story for Christmas
bbcfour.uk.description: A Christmas ghost story about a long-running radio horror series. Contains some scenes which some viewers may find upsetting. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: Bolsover Castle with Lucy...
bbcfour.uk.description: ...Worsley: Secret Knowledge. Lucy Worsley tells the story of Bolsover Castle in Derbyshire. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.description: Programmes start at 7.00pm.

bbcfour.uk.title: This is BBC Four
bbcfour.uk.description: Programmes start at 7.00pm.

bbcfour.uk.title: Alaska: Earth's Frozen Kingdom
bbcfour.uk.description: 2/3. Three-part series examining the harsh elements and rich rewards of the Alaskan wilderness. Summer is a narrow window of plenty when the land is bathed in 24-hour sunlight. [S,AD]

bbcfour.uk.title: The Story of Scottish Art
bbcfour.uk.description: 2/4. Lachlan Goudie traces the development of Scottish art. This episode examines the 18th century, a period that heralded the greatest blossoming of Scottish artistry in its history.

bbcfour.uk.title: Mastermind: 1977
bbcfour.uk.description: 14/17. Specialist subjects include venomous reptiles, France in the 17th century and Tolkien.

bbcfour.uk.title: Call My Bluff
bbcfour.uk.description: Robert Robinson hosts as Frank Muir, Jane Lapotaire and Dr Robert Burchfield take on Arthur Marshall, Ruth Madoc and Melvyn Bragg in the popular panel game of word definitions and deceptions.

bbcfour.uk.title: The Sky at Night
bbcfour.uk.description: The team journey to La Palma, where giant new telescopes and cutting-edge science are opening extraordinary new windows to the universe.

bbcfour.uk.title: Joan Sutherland
bbcfour.uk.description: Soprano Joan Sutherland talks to Bernard Levin and sings scenes from some of her most celebrated roles. With the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Richard Bonynge.

bbcfour.uk.title: Metalworks! The Knight's Tale

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Hired to infiltrate a group of ecoterrorists, an undercover operative (Brit Marling) instead finds herself growing sympathetic to the cause and attracted to the leader (Alexander Skarsgård). - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity. - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: An unexpected odyssey rolls out when a filmmaker's brother begins receiving unusually advanced paintings from a girl, supposedly 8 years old. - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemax.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis). - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemax.us.description: P.T. Barnum indulges his limitless imagination to create the Barnum & Bailey circus in the 1800s. Featuring musical numbers, exotic performers and daring feats, the mesmerizing spectacle takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) forms an enduring bond with June Carter (Reese Witherspoon) and struggles with drug addiction on the way to music stardom. - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve. - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean organizes a gang to steal $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos in a single heist. - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe. - 2004

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemax.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemax.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemax.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemax.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: It
cinemax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-02-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Animation, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2013-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Apparition
cinemaxaction.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enemy
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2013-12-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Destroy All Monsters!
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens. (Action, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1968-08-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. (Action, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1964-12-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blood Simple
cinemaxaction.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea: he follows the two lovers, and... (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1984-07-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Extraction
cinemaxaction.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-12-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Rover
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. gameshowcentral.us.title: America Says
gameshowcentral.us.description: Game show series have been making a comeback in television, and media and "America Says" is no exception. This program is following in the footsteps of the popular mobile app game "HQ Trivia." The network is planning its own spin on the game show, and Fran Shea, evp, programming and marketing, says she "has been studying the GSN audience and prepared a slate of new shows that reflect what it wants: family-friendly, fun, escapist television." In "America Says," two teams face off to guess Americans' responses to questions covering a variety of topics. Michael Higgins is the host. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20180618

gameshowcentral.us.description: If you buy into the title of this game show, you might be an idiot if you can't answer the questions asked of contestants. The winning pair takes home the money earned in the game and plays the bonus round, where even more cash is up for grabs. Comic Ben Gleib hosts the show that isn't afraid to call its players idiots. gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It
gameshowcentral.us.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

In Fort Worth, Ned discovers Clevenger is battling the burgeoning railroad and decides to fight back using the power of the press. (Western) - 1951

gritxtra.us.title: Best of the Badmen
gritxtra.us.description: After the North defeats the South, Union Maj. Jeff Clanton heads to Missouri to provide the Confederacy's Quantrill's Raiders a chance to claim allegiance to the Union, thereby clearing their wanted status. But standing in Clanton's way are the corrupt lawmen Joad and Fowler, who would rather keep the men outlaws to collect the reward on their heads. After Joad and Fowler frame Clanton for murder, he manages to escape, becoming an outlaw himself. (Movie, Western) - 1951-08-09

gritxtra.us.title: Ride, Vaquero
gritxtra.us.description: After the Civil War, King Cameron (Howard Keel) moves to Texas, purchases a cattle ranch and settles down with his wife, Cordelia (Ava Gardner). They find themselves at the mercy of Jose Esqueda (Anthony Quinn), a local bandit who has terrorized the town with his adoptive brother, Rio (Robert Taylor). Rio is kidnapped when he tries to mount an attack on the ranch and agrees to work for Cameron so he can be close to Cordelia. Though he's incensed at Rio's betrayal, Jose vows to get him back. (Drama, Movie, Western) - 1953-07-15

gritxtra.us.title: Billy the Kid
gritxtra.us.description: The story of the notorious outlaw William "Billy the Kid" Bonney. Billy joins a group of outlaws in a South West town when he meets old friend Jim Sherwood, now the town's marshal. He tries to change his ways but when a friend is murdered he falls back into the life of a bandit. (Drama, Movie, Western) - 1941-05-30

gritxtra.us.title: Devil's Doorway
gritxtra.us.description: Lance Poole (Robert Taylor) is a Native American who left his tribal homelands to fight for the Union in the Civil War. Despite earning the Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic duties in the line of fire, when he returns home he's still faced with hatred and racism from the white community that neighbors his village. Unable to own property because he's not considered a citizen of the United States, he fights a lawyer's (Louis Calhern) attempts to take over his tribe's hard-earned land. (Movie, Western) - 1950

gritxtra.us.title: Many Rivers to Cross
gritxtra.us.description: Headstrong Mary Stuart Cherne (Eleanor Parker) is in hot pursuit of frontiersman Bushrod Gentry (Robert Taylor), and is determined to make him her husband. Naturally, Bushrod has no desire to leave the happy, wandering life of a trapper. He heads north to escape Mary's nuptial advances. But with hostile Shawnee Indians at every turn, Bushrod and Mary must set aside their differences and work together to survive the wilds of the unfamiliar territory. (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Western) - 1955-02-04

gritxtra.us.title: Westward the Women
gritxtra.us.description: There's a deficit of good, honest women in the West, and Roy Whitman (John McIntire) wants to change that. His solution is to bring a caravan of over 100 mail-order brides from Chicago to California. It will be a long, difficult and dangerous journey for the women. So Whitman hires hardened, cynical Buck Wyatt (Robert Taylor) to be their guide across the inhospitable frontier. But as disaster strikes on the trail, Buck just might discover that these women are stronger than he thinks. (Drama, Movie, Western) - 1951

gritxtra.us.title: Return of the Gunfighter
gritxtra.us.description: Ben Wyatt (Robert Taylor) is an aging gunfighter who has grown weary of his lifestyle. But when an old friend, Luis (Rodolfo Hoyos Jr.), asks for help defending his land, Ben can't say no. Unfortunately, he arrives too late, finding Luis and his entire family -- except daughter Anisa (Ana Martín) -- murdered. Ben is determined to get revenge against the killers, and in pursuing them reluctantly enlists the aid a younger gunfighter, Lee Sutton (Chad Everett). (Movie, Western) - 1967-01-28

gritxtra.us.title: The Law and Jake Wade
gritxtra.us.description: Bandits Clint Hollister (Richard Widmark) and Jake Wade (Robert Taylor) botch a robbery that ends with Clint imprisoned. Despairing, Jake leaves the loot in an abandoned village and quits crime for good. Now working for the law, Jake helps free his old cohort from jail. Clint doesn't want the treasure to go to waste, however, so he forces Jake and his girlfriend, Peggy (Patricia Owens), to lead him to the stash. But to unearth the money, they'll have to get past dangerous Comanche warriors. (Movie, Western) - 1958-07-15

gritxtra.us.title: Saddle the Wind
gritxtra.us.description: Steve Sinclair (Robert Taylor) is a former gunfighter and soldier who left his violent ways behind him after the Civil War. Since then, he has settled down as a rancher in a small Western town. But his easygoing life is turned upside down when his unstable little brother, Tony (John Cassavetes), shows up with his bride-to-be, Joan (Julie London). While Steve has given up his gun-toting ways, Tony has not, and his violent tendencies lead to trouble for the entire town. (Movie, Western) - 1958-03-05

gritxtra.us.title: Thunder Over the Plains
gritxtra.us.description: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteren Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses. (Movie, Western) - 1953

gritxtra.us.title: Westbound
gritxtra.us.description: A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier. (Movie, Western) - 1959

As the temperature rises underground, the highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors on the facility's inhabitants -- human and otherwise. (Horror, Science fiction, Comedy) - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Lockbox
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Seeking peace after her mother's death, Ellen retreats to a rural town and takes in her severely traumatized cousin, Winthrop. Their fragile domestic balance soon shatters when an erratic neighbor warns her that Winthrop is dangerous. As strange phenomena start to escalate, Ellen must put everything on the line to defend Winthrop from a dangerous, otherworldly entity that's determined to track him down. (Horror, Thriller) - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Red Eye
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Stigmata
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A young woman with no strong religious beliefs, Frankie Paige (Patricia Arquette) begins having strange and violent experiences, showing signs of the wounds that Jesus received when crucified. When the Vatican gets word of Frankie's situation, a high-ranking cardinal (Jonathan Pryce) requests that the Rev. Andrew Kiernan (Gabriel Byrne) investigate her case. Soon Kiernan realizes that very sinister forces are at work, and tries to rescue Frankie from the entity that is plaguing her. (Thriller) - 1999

mlbnetwork.us.description: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Oh, Pol-y Night ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Ho, oh, no. It's Christmas season in Michigan and Dr Pol and his team make their patient list, check it twice, and treat those who are naughty, spotty, snotty and nice.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Wizard of Paws ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: It's a dog's world at Pol Clinic, and the vets have their paws full of a crew of pups.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry - Vietnam ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Hannah Fry explores Vietnam's remarkable post-war transformation. From moped chaos in Ho Chi Minh City to the muddy graft of prawn harvest in the Mekong Delta and a restorative spa bath in Sapa, Hannah reveals a nation embracing change.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry - Greece ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Hannah Fry journeys across islands, mountains and olive groves to reveal why ancient Greece was the birthplace of so many big ideas. She decodes the Parthenon's geometry, sails the Aegean with ancient tools, tries her hand at olive farming, and more.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Tucci in Italy - Lombardy ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Stanley explores the pioneering spirit of Italy's industrial heartland, where the cuisine and ingredients are defiantly forward-thinking.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Tucci in Italy - Trentino-Alto Adige ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Stanley delves into the identity of Italy's northernmost region, where many speak German as well as Italian, and the cuisine reflects both cultures.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Tucci in Italy - Abruzzo ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Stanley discovers surprises in this wild region he has never visited before; he investigates how the rugged terrain influences the food and culture; high in sheep country, he prepares mutton on a traditional barbecue.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Baby Animals Down Under - Bush Babies ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Meet some of the adorable youngsters that grow up in the iconic Australian bush.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets - Snacking the Inedible ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The Critter Fixer team helps a few best friends who bite off more than they can chew. Olive the dog feasted on an entire tennis ball. (S5 Ep2)

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Tsunami: Race Against Time - Breaking News ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: As the wave hits Sri Lanka and the tragedy expands across the Indian Ocean, journalists strive to understand the scope of events so that they can convey it to the rest of the world.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Tsunami: Race Against Time - Rescue ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Tourists on an island band together to survive in the aftermath of a tsunami. Though there are hundreds of casualties, they must work hard to save as many lives as possible.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Mutant Weather - Mutant Megastorms ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Climate change means warmer ocean temperatures and higher sea levels which are intensifying hurricanes. Some experts say we should add a Category six to the Saffir-Simpson hurricane wind scale.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Wild Hunters - Snakes ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: When on the hunt, snakes judge to perfection the very instant that separates life from death.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Fish Tank Kings - Pimp My Tank ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Mat meets up with Allan Marshall, who runs biological operations at the Florida Aquarium and wants to showcase rarely seen deep sea fish.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Fish Tank Kings - Card Sharks ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Mat gets a call from a recording studio in Sin City with a tank that has aged prematurely, while Francis needs to move a shark called Bessie.

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Life Below Zero: Next Generation - Ensnared ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Resilient Alaskans must harness scarce resources to endure harsh winter. (Reality, Documentary, Outdoors, Adventure) - 2023-09-12

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Life Below Zero: Next Generation - Wolf Territory ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Alaskans work hard to prepare for winter's brutally harsh elements. (Reality, Documentary, Outdoors, Adventure) - 2023-09-19

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - One Angry Muskox ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr Michelle Oakley diagnoses terminally ill patients and gets chased by a muskox. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2014-04-19

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Teleshopping
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment. (Shopping, Consumer) - 2002-03-06

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Bizarre Animal Friends - The Most Unlikely of All ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A round-up of the most peculiar and most affectionate pairings between surprisingly different animals. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2012-11-24

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets - Say Hello to My Little Bunny ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The docs help a fainting goat and a mule that needs a pedicure. (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2021-06-26

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Humungosaur ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A family is plagued by Mozambique spitting cobras, their 6-year-old girl was bitten in the face by one and now there's another in their house. Sioux gets a nasty surprise as a whip snake bites her on the arm and won't let go. (Reality, Animals, Documentary) - 2018-10-12

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Animals Gone Wild - Freak Encounters ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A selection of profoundly unpredictable incidents, from a trespassing bear and a quick-witted sea lion to a slippery serpent surprise. (Documentary, Animals) - 2014-06-12

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind - Down Under ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: From thirsty koalas and boxing kangaroos to parrots that surf on cars and bad-tempered wombats, we discover the most unusual and unruly behaviours of fauna from Australia and New Zealand. (Documentary) - 2025-09-24

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Heartland Docs, DVM - Chicken: Impossible ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A chicken lays an egg while under anaesthesia; a puppy has a rubbish gut; the vets come together to save a mare in labour. (Reality, Animals) - 2022-06-05

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Baby Animals Down Under - Bush Babies ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Meet some of the adorable youngsters that grow up in the iconic Australian bush. (Documentary, Animals) - 2026-03-30

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Europe From Above - Alps ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: An aerial view over the Alps region reveals a solar panel engineering feat, a hot air balloon festival and a flight alongside the Northern Bald Ibis. (Documentary, Travel)

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: When Sharks Attack - Space Coast Scare ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In 2003 along Florida's Space Coast, the power of rockets high above are rivalled by the terror of the depths down below. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-07-13

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Airport Security: Peru and Brazil - Busted Baggage ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: When agents at Jorge Chavez International Airport detain a man with drugs in his suitcase, he breaks down when speaking with his mother. Meanwhile, a woman may be carrying cocaine-contaminated olives. (Documentary, Crime) - 2020-05-07

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Dr. O and the Three Bears ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley helps a dog that was attacked while protecting its owner and a guinea pig with raspy breathing. She also has a look at a lynx with deformed legs. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2021-04-17

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa - Crash Landing ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: ZooTampa rolls out the red carpet for new arrivals, big and small. (Animals, Nature) - 2023-01-01

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Land Of 10,000 Grizzlies ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: In the far east of Russia, a mountainous peninsula is home to volcanoes, geysers, and one of the world's largest populations of grizzly bears. (Special, Documentary, Animals) - 2015-07-13

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Dragons Uncovered ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: The Komodo dragon has captured our imaginations for more than a century, but we are only now discovering some of its most wondrous secrets. (Special, Animals, Documentary) - 2024-10-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Something Bit Me! - This Is Not a Deer! ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: A stay in the jungle of Costa Rica turns into a horror trip for the location scout of a production company. An encounter with an animal inhabitant of the jungle leads him into a nightmarish race. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2022-02-27

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Ice Road Rescue - Blizzard Showdown ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Bjoern finds himself in a difficult situation when a double accident forces him to ask his rivals for help. On the other side of the mountain, Thord must rescue a 14-tonne tractor that threatens to tip over on top of prime real estate. (Reality, Travel, Nature, Outdoors) - 2022-11-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Casey and Brutus: Grizzly Encounters - Project Kodiak ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Casey immerses himself in grizzly life on Alaska's Kodiak Island, hoping for some top salmon fishing tips from the wild ones to take back to his captive bear Brutus. (Documentary, Animals) - 2010-08-25

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Snakes in the City - Snakes & Ladders ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Simon and Sioux continue to train their apprentice Mbali before heading to the snake capital of the world. It is monsoon season in the Indian city of Mysore and local snake catcher Snake Shyam needs help. (Reality, Animals, Documentary) - 2023-07-03

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol - Pol-tergeist ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Halloween is coming, and Dr Pol is in his element dealing with jumping, flailing, and barking clientele. Charles has some tricks up his sleeves, but that's nothing compared to the surprises patients bring, as Dr Pol is hit with blood, pee, and a kick in the knee. The doc and family visit a haunted yard, but after dealing with an angry herd of beef cattle, a pair of ill-mannered sugar gliders, and a skittish stallion, Dr Pol ain't scared of no ghosts! (Holiday, Reality, Animals) - 2014-10-25

nationalgeographicwild.us.title: Yukon Vet - Like Mother, Like Daughter ᴺᵉʷ
nationalgeographicwild.us.description: Dr. Oakley performs a checkup on two scrappy lynx, and Sierra takes charge on clinic day. (Reality, Animals, Medical) - 2023-05-13

Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull. (Comedy, Drama, Western) - 1976

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Super-Charlie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young boy attempts to solve an ongoing series of crimes with the help of his super-powered baby brother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hitpig!

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Smurfs

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Chicken Run
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Bad Guys 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reformed criminals Mr. Wolf, Mr. Snake, Mr. Piranha, Mr. Shark and Ms. Tarantula find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes heist that's masterminded by a new team of delinquents they never saw coming -- the Bad Girls.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Minions
skycinemafamily.uk.description: On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female super-villain.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Charlie the Wonderdog
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A dog gains superpowers after his owner is abducted by aliens. Together they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Babe
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: Charlie Bucket comes from a poor family, and spends most of his time dreaming about the chocolate that he loves but usually can't afford. Things change when Willy Wonka, head of the very popular Wonka Chocolate empire, announces a contest in which five gold tickets have been hidden in chocolate bars. Charlie is one of the five kids who find a lucky ticket and goes on a tour of Wonka's chocolate factory.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Open Season

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon

When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit 2
