sportsmanchannel.us.title: Wardens - Snowmobiles and Oktoberfest
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Michigan conservation officers patrol a weekend party and make sure snowmobilers are riding safely and stay out of danger.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Chasing the 29 - The Elusive Eland by Day & Jackals by Night
sportsmanchannel.us.description: The pursuit of the African 29 continues as Chase takes on two very different hunts in the African Bush; during the day, he sets his sights on Eland; when the sun goes down, the hunt takes a completely different turn.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Everything Eichler - Whitetails and Hogs Down South
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Bows, rifles and handguns are all coming out to go after whitetails and hogs in Florida.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Art of Wild - Long Shot
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Nick's Dad grinds it out in Ohio in search of filling his tag and hopes the late season will bring him a change of luck.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Stompin' groundz - Flying Solo
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Veteran hunter goes solo without his son for Texas big buck action.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: WildFed - Savannah Hog and Fiddler Crab
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Chef Tony Seichrist hosts Daniel in Savannah, Georgia to hunt invasive hogs, fish for sheepshead and sea bass, and to taste their way around the region.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Our Way of Life - Sea Otter
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Heather Douville reconnects with her Tlingit heritage through teachings from her father, Mike Douville; a recognition of the critical need to safeguard traditional food sources and maintain ecosystem balance.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: M2D Camo's Livin' the Dream - New Zealand Poronui
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Sparky goes to New Zealand stag and sika hunting at Poronui.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Hunter - The Texas Challenge
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Dave hunts South TX in late February for a management buck. But the challenge becomes trying to find one that hasn't shed his antlers yet!

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Whitetail Properties - Chasing Creation
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Illinois Land Specialist Tyler Sellens chases which ever critter is in season. Florida turkeys, Illinois cold weather bucks, and everything in between.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Jon Thelen's Destination Fish - Harry Truman Crappies in the Trees & Early Summer Jigging
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Jon drops into Missouri's Harry S. Truman Lake, targeting crappies stacked in flooded timber. He details how sonar and pinpoint jig placement turn a maze of branches into a crappie goldmine.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: The Fishmonger - Fairhope Fish House
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Follow the fish from the Gulf of Mexico to a local restaurant near Mobile, Alabama. Join a dedicated and passionate crew of four whose goal is quit their "regular" jobs and fish full-time. Tommy connects with a shrimper with a story to tell.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Bill Dance Saltwater - Nothing Like Memories Part 2
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Bill and Bass Pro Shops founder Johnny Morris are making memories along Florida's Space Coast!

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Larry Smith Outdoors - Big Sturgeon Bay Perch
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Larry fishes Sturgeon Bay with perch specialist Nick from Hook Line And Sinker Guide Service, using bugs.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Two Conchs Adventures - The Two Conchs Experience
sportsmanchannel.us.description: Joined by repeat client Bryan Russel, the plan is to head offshore for mahi mahi, permit and cobia.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: In Fisherman TV - Busting Bodacious Beasts
sportsmanchannel.us.description: The In-Fisherman staff goes into beast-busting mode, as they fish for the Niagara River's brutish smallmouths; stretch the limits of heavy-duty tackle for bruiser blue cats; and take you down a historic road of discovery in the quest for muskies.

sportsmanchannel.us.title: Winchester Deadly Passion - Alberta Back to Back

themoviechannel.us.description: A decorated career Marine (Samuel L. Jackson), about to stand trial for a botched rescue mission, asks an old friend (Tommy Lee Jones) to defend him. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Bleed for This
themoviechannel.us.description: With help from trainer Kevin Rooney, champion boxer Vinny Pazienza tries to make a comeback after breaking his neck in a car accident. - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
themoviechannel.us.description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States. - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen). - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
themoviechannel.us.description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child. - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school. - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
themoviechannel.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Love and Monsters
themoviechannel.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Urban Cowboy
themoviechannel.us.description: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. (Drama) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
themoviechannel.us.description: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve. (Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Flypaper
themoviechannel.us.description: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: View From the Top
themoviechannel.us.description: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. (Comedy, Romance, Drama) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
themoviechannel.us.description: When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship. (Children, Comedy) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. (Comedy) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Kingpin
themoviechannel.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
themoviechannel.us.description: The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. (Fantasy, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Hugo
themoviechannel.us.description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home. (Adventure, Fantasy, Drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: Mr. Holmes
themoviechannel.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. (Mystery, Drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Our Ghosts
themoviechannel.us.description: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. (Comedy drama) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: Three Wishes
themoviechannel.us.description: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. (Fantasy) - 1995

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cabaret
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Multiple Oscars went to this tale about an American chanteuse in Berlin caught in the rising tide of Nazism. - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lola
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A cabaret singer (Barbara Sukowa) corrupts a stuffy city planner (Armin Mueller-Stahl) in 1957 Germany. - 1982

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wheeler Dealers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Texas oil rascal (James Garner) woos a Wall Street stock analyst (Lee Remick) and takes the market for a ride. - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The High Cost of Loving
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Just as a corporate executive (Jose Ferrer) fears losing his job, his wife (Gena Rowlands) thinks she's finally pregnant. - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Breakdown
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A boxer (William Bishop) jailed for murder proves his girlfriend's (Ann Richards) wealthy father and a ward boss framed him. - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Casablanca
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A cynical nightclub owner in Casablanca protects an old flame and her husband from Nazis, while also trying to navigate his complicated past. - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bad and the Beautiful
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A ruthless producer (Kirk Douglas) uses and discards Hollywood hopefuls as stepping stones to the top of the Tinseltown heap. - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: It Started With a Kiss
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An Air Force sergeant (Glenn Ford) and his bride (Debbie Reynolds) try abstinence and tour Spain in a Lincoln Futura won in a raffle. - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Kiss Me Kate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Lilli and Fred act the same way offstage as they do in The Taming of the Shrew. - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gone to Earth
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Folklore and desire stir an 1890s girl (Jennifer Jones) who lives with her father in English fox-hunting country. - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Duel in the Sun
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tragedy seems to follow Pearl Chavez everywhere she goes. After a domestic dispute results in the death of both of her parents, Pearl moves in with her aunt, Laura Belle, on an expansive farm. When Pearl notices Laura Belle's son, the fiery Lewt, life on the ranch erupts into chaos. The two have a brief courtship, but Lewt abruptly ends the relationship. When Pearl tries to move on, Lewt's jealousy leads to a climactic gun battle between the former lovers. (Western) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wizard of Oz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young Dorothy (Dorothy Dwan), a farm girl from Kansas, discovers that she's actually Princess Dorothea, the royal heir to a faraway kingdom called Oz. Suddenly, a powerful tornado whisks Dorothy, her uncle Henry (Frank Alexander) and three farmhands to the magical kingdom. There Dorothy is hailed as the queen of the land by all except authoritarian Prime Minister Kruel (Joseph Swickard), who casts a curse on Dorothy in an attempt to maintain his dictatorial reign. (Fantasy) - 1925

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Stolen Kisses
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The third in a series of films featuring François Truffaut's alter-ego, Antoine Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud), the story resumes with Antoine being discharged from military service. His sweetheart Christine's (Claude Jade) father lands Antoine a job as a security guard, which he promptly loses. Stumbling into a position assisting a private detective, Antoine falls for his employers' seductive wife, Fabienne (Delphine Seyrig), and finds that he must choose between the older woman and Christine. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Soft Skin
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While flying to Lisbon, Portugal, to give a lecture, a writer and magazine editor, Pierre Lachenay (Jean Desailly), encounters an attractive flight attendant, Nicole (Françoise Dorléac), and winds up spending the night with her. What was intended to be a one-night stand becomes a tumultuous extramarital affair once he gets back to Paris and his wife (Nelly Benedetti) and kids. Pierre tries to keep the affair secret, but, when his wife suspects him, she snaps. (Romance) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Happiness Ahead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A bored heiress (Josephine Hutchinson) leaves high society and falls in love with a window washer (Dick Powell). (Musical comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Here Comes Happiness
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A rich girl (Mildred Coles) loves a sandblaster (Edward Norris) instead of the socialite (Richard Ainley) her mother wants her to marry. (Romance) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Princess O'Rourke
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters. (Romantic comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Wise Girl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A socialite (Miriam Hopkins) goes Bohemian to save her sister's children from their starving-artist father (Ray Milland) in Greenwich Village. (Comedy) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Traveling Saleslady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A toothpaste tycoon's daughter (Joan Blondell) sells an inventor's new brand to teach her father a lesson. (Comedy) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: There Goes My Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eager to break free of her constrained life, heiress Joan Butterfield (Virginia Bruce) runs away from her grandfather's yacht just as reporter Bill Spencer (Fredric March) arrives to get a rare photo of her. Befriended by the kind Peggy (Patsy Kelly), Joan takes an assumed name and moves in with Peggy, then joins her working at Butterfield's department store. Bill, who has begun an article on Joan, visits the store and, recognizing her there, realizes that he has stumbled upon a hot story. (Romance) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Repent at Leisure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young man falls in love with his boss's daughter. (Comedy drama) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love and Learn
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A New York socialite (Martha Vickers) plays working girl around two struggling songwriters (Jack Carson, Robert Hutton). (Musical comedy) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Richest Girl in the World
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dorothy Hunter (Miriam Hopkins), the richest girl in the world, has never shown her face to the public. When she arrives in America, Dorothy switches places with her secretary, Sylvia (Fay Wray), to avoid the press. But after Dorothy's fiancé (George Meeker) proclaims his love for another woman, she wonders if any man can love her for more than her money. Still disguised as a secretary, Dorothy falls for Tony (Joel McCrea) and puts him through a series of tests to prove his affections. (Comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bride by Mistake
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has. (Drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sun Valley Serenade
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: As a surefire way to receive good press, bandleader Phil Corey (Glenn Miller) and his ensemble decide to adopt a war refugee. When it turns out that their adoptee isn't a child, but a pretty Scandinavian woman named Karen Benson (Sonja Henie), it leads to a flirtatious relationship with the group's pianist, Ted Scott (John Payne), who is already involved with singer Vivian Dawn (Lynn Bari). As the band heads to snowy Idaho for a gig, romantic drama, skiing, ice skating and musical numbers ensue. (Musical, Romance) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Orchestra Wives
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a touring swing band arrives in her small town, Connie Ward (Ann Rutherford) falls hard for trumpeter Bill Abbot (George Montgomery) and decides to marry him on a whim -- since the band is leaving as quickly as it arrived. Quite unprepared for her new lifestyle, Connie struggles to adjust to the constant travel from one town to another, and also to the pettiness of the other musicians' wives. Eventually, the marriage and the band break up, but Bill is determined to make it all right again. (Musical, Romance) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Birth of the Blues
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jeff Lambert (Bing Crosby), who has grown up in New Orleans surrounded by black music, determines to start a band featuring white cornet player Memphis (Brian Donlevy). However, the Basin Street Hotshots are rejected from several venues for playing "black" jazz, until singer Betty Lou Cobb (Mary Martin) insists they be hired as her backup band. The band finds success until Jeff and Memphis fall out over Betty Lou, then get entangled with gangster Blackie (J. Carrol Naish). (Musical) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Girl Crazy

actionmax.us.title: Game Night
actionmax.us.description: A couple's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when their friends agree to participate in a murder mystery party. They soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Trance
actionmax.us.description: A criminal (Vincent Cassel) hires a hypnotherapist (Rosario Dawson) to probe the mind of a brain-injured auctioneer (James McAvoy) to uncover the hiding place of a stolen painting. - 2013

actionmax.us.title: The Apparition
actionmax.us.description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run. - 2012

actionmax.us.title: Enemy
actionmax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. - 2013

actionmax.us.title: Destroy All Monsters!
actionmax.us.description: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens. - 1968

actionmax.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
actionmax.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. - 1964

actionmax.us.title: Blood Simple
actionmax.us.description: Complications arise when the owner of a Texas bar pays a man (M. Emmet Walsh) to kill his wife (Frances McDormand) and her lover (John Getz). - 1984

actionmax.us.title: Extraction
actionmax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. - 2015

actionmax.us.title: The Rover
actionmax.us.description: After thieves steal his car, a hardened loner (Guy Pearce) forces a wounded member (Robert Pattinson) of their gang to help him track them down across a scorched and perilous landscape. - 2014

actionmax.us.title: Mickey 17
actionmax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. - 2025

actionmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth. - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Human survivors of a plague threaten Caesar's growing nation of genetically evolved apes. Though they reach a fragile peace, soon both sides are brought to the brink of a war that will determine which will become Earth's dominant species. - 2014

actionmax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: The Mountain Between Us
actionmax.us.description: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: The Shape of Water
actionmax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
actionmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
actionmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
actionmax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
actionmax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Open Water
actionmax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

actionmax.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
actionmax.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Scream
actionmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

actionmax.us.title: Trap
actionmax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: The Watchers
actionmax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 A look at some of the most incredible escapes of World War II.

sbssydney.au.description: E312 Episode 312 Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbssydney.au.title: Richard E. Grant's Very Modern Odyssey
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Sicily Richard E Grant's adventure brings him to vibrant Sicily, the home of the legendary Cyclops monster, where he cooks with a Duchess and performs in an ancient amphitheatre.

sbssydney.au.title: Lost Treasures Of Arabia
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Ancient City Of Dadan Archaeologists and historians investigate the mysteries of AlUla, uncovering the people, events and cultures that shaped this ancient landscape and its enduring artistic legacy.

sbssydney.au.title: Lost Treasures Of Arabia
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 The Nabataean Kingdom Archaeologists and historians investigate the mysteries of AlUla, uncovering the people, events and cultures that shaped this ancient landscape and its enduring artistic legacy.

sbssydney.au.title: Ancient Superstructures
sbssydney.au.description: S3 E1 Holy Sepulchre - The Sacred Shield This episode reveals the secrets of construction of the Holy Sepulchre, the most sacred Christian site in the world. The Holy Sepulchre reveals its secrets as never before through new techniques.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Sridevi and Yash meet, fall in love and get married. But when Yash discovers he has been granted a medical traineeship in Australia, they are forced to live apart.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 As Yash leaves India for his medial traineeship in Australia, Sridevi is left at home with his family and the hopes for her future on hold. Four years later, Sridevi arrives in Australia.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Yash takes Sridevi on a surprise date to a waterhole in the Australian wilderness. It is romantic and passionate, but when Sridevi says she wants to start a family, Yash reacts badly.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 With the new resolve to tell no more lies, Sridevi decides it is time to confess her own secret, which threatens to end their already rocky relationship.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Yash throws himself into work and study as Sridevi finds happiness in a new job and her friendship with Gabs.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 Episode 6 Sridevi and Yash finally find joy in their unexpected pregnancy, but just as they move closer to their dream life, their joy starts slipping through their fingers.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E7 Episode 7 With his exam looming, Yash is laser-focused but barely coping. When he doesn't return home after his exam, Sridevi is forced to ask Jamal for help.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E8 Episode 8 Back in India for Yash's sister's wedding, Sridevi and Yash are forced to confront the truth about what they each want in life.

sbssydney.au.title: Legacy List With Matt Paxton
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E6 Lights, Camera, Downsize A retired entertainment executive needs Matt's help clearing out a basement full of showbiz memorabilia. The collection includes autographs, posters and rare pictures of Hollywood's Golden Age.

sbssydney.au.title: Auction
sbssydney.au.description: S8 E11 Episode 11 After JFK's assassination, Jacqueline Kennedy sought comfort in David Ormsby-Gore. Their intimate letters found 50 years later, reveal a poignant love story ending with her rejecting his proposal.

sbssydney.au.title: Bamay
sbssydney.au.description: S2 E2 Murrumbidgee River - Ngunawal, Wiradjuri & Ngarigo Country A slow TV showcase of the stunning landscapes found in Ngunawal, Wiradjuri and Ngarigo Country along the waters of the Murrumbidgee River.

sbssydney.au.title: Pandore

sbssydney.au.title: Prisoner
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E5 Welcome Home, Soldier Youssef is in a coma, and Sammi feels he is put in a moral dilemma. If he comes clean about what happened, the officers gets what he deserves, but he'll be ostracized by all the other officers.

sbssydney.au.title: Prisoner
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 The House Always Wins The officers expect the worst in response to Youssef's death. The two rival gangs start talking to each other in the corners, and this is surely a bad sign.

sbssydney.au.title: Legacy List With Matt Paxton
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E7 Mom's Moving Story An only child has some tough decisions to make when they're forced to downsize the family home after their mom moves into a care facility. Emotions run high as they find cherished mementos.

sbssydney.au.title: Legacy List With Matt Paxton
sbssydney.au.description: S5 E8 No Country For Old Things A woman about to retire must clear out her entire house before moving to France. Matt helps with the downsize and keeps an eye out for a handful of items she won't leave home without.

sbssydney.au.title: Auction
sbssydney.au.description: S8 E12 Episode 12 During a New York heatwave, global bidders converge as Basquiat's works hit Christie's and Sotheby's. Sotheby's leads with 'Untitled', unseen for 30 years, poised to break records over $100 million.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E5 Fire Engine, Shepherd's Hut And Telescope A couple turn an old fire engine into a bar, to raise money for charity. Max builds a shepherds Hut from scratch, including the nuts and bolts! George visits an extraordinary home in Chile and Will builds a telescope.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E4 Caleb Harper, Dami Im, Nikki Britton & Andrew Maxwell We look at Eurovision history. Australia has tonight's guest, Dami Im. Ireland has Dustin the Turkey. Plus, Spacey Jane's Caleb Harper, comedians Nikki Britton and Andrew Maxwell. Julia Jacklin closes the show.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S15 E6 Night David Mitchell, Noel Fielding and Holly Walsh join regular panellist Alan Davies and host Sandi Toksvig to contemplate the theme of 'night'.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E7 Episode 7 Rob Brydon is back as host with team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests John Cooper Clarke, Lucia Keskin, Kadiff Kirwan, and Sara Pascoe.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Building Home ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Keith and Kate have returned to the Scottish seaside town of Dunoon, where her dad grew up and she holidayed annually. But restoring the grand Victorian house they bought comes with costly surprises.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Recipe of the Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 It's time to fire up the BBQ as the remaining home cooks head outside to create their best BBQ recipes, as judged by frontline volunteers of the SES.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E12 Post Mortem Carter rebukes Benton for his seeming lack of concern over Gant's death. Jeanie hits it off with a handsome infectious disease expert. Carol takes the blame for a patient's death, and Ross considers being Charlie's guardian.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Offsiders
ABCMESydney.au.description: E40 Abbey Gelmi and the panel discuss the week in sport including the Rugby League World Cup Semi Finals, Week 1 of the AFLW Finals, WBBL, team selections ahead of the Australia v England One Day Series and Wallabies Spring Tour.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage New Music ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E312 Discover the wildest new music videos on rage. Essential grooves and boundary-pushing visuals from Australia and beyond.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E4 Schooling When Charlie's school gets a bad Ofsted rating, Lee and Lucy start looking around for alternative schools. Geoffrey and Wendy offer to pay to send Charlie to private school, which presents Lee and Lucy with a moral dilemma.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E8 Reflections Sandi Toksvig takes some time to 'reflect' as she asks Alan Davies, Joe Lycett, Zoe Lyons and Liza Tarbuck some impossible and interesting questions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Altrincham Phil Spencer advises on how to spruce up and sell a three-bedroom detached cottage on the outskirts of Manchester that has been on the market for a staggering four years with no offers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Noel It's been five years since we last saw the Worsleys, with Paul and Ally on the verge of splitting and Jim and Jackie in turmoil. Things are no less dramatic now as Luke and girlfriend Maya drop a bombshell at Christmas dinner.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 No Alternative The reality of Luke's announcement hits, and Paul and Ally worry about the decision he and Maya have made. As a New Year starts, the Worsley family gather together with Maya's family, united in their love and worry.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Breeders
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E3 No Age Ally is appalled that she’s about to turn 50 and bans the family from ever mentioning that number. Paul tries to help Luke, who is overwhelmed by learning to drive and becoming a dad, while Ava meets a charismatic girl called Holly.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Albania Stephen Fry hosts the world's most impossible quiz show. Lining up to tackle the tricky questions on this episode are Alan Davies, Clive Anderson, Linda Smith and Sean Lock.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E8 Crystals Have Power Jake takes a vow of non-violence, which is inconvenient when they're attacked by marauders from the crystal dimension.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 A Tale of Two Ice Bears The Bears accidentally clone Ice Bear and Ice Bear has a hard time adjusting.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E39 What's Opera, Titans? Robin surprises the Titans with a trip to the opera, but they soon fall asleep, and all dream about starring in their own operas.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E40 Sideline Dad When the Girls start playing soccer, the Professor goes overboard.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E15 Zombizou The sweet Miss Bustier gets akumatized into Zombizou. Armed with an evil black lipstick, she wants to spread love in the city... by force. Ladybug and Cat Noir can't get zombizoufied if they want to save Paris!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E6 The Nurse Celeste lies that she started the fire to be sent home. Sally confronts Matron about her eyesight while Miss Grayling tells Celeste about her Mother.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Pilot Hannah and Leo arrive at OME. Chan-Mi, who doesn't see the point in learning English, connects with Hannah when they sing together. Impressed with her vocal talents, Ken asks Hannah if she's ever considered being a trainee.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 The Germblock Melanie is very upset when Tamara 'germblocks' Melanie, the rule that forces someone to be isolated if they have done something disgusting. Tamara has accused Melanie of not washing her hands after going to the toilet.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E26 Turning Over A Nuzleaf When our heroes get separated from their Pokemon in a deep, dark cave, both groups find themselves in trouble!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 Last Hope: Part 2 With time of the essence, the Terrans unite to bring down Mandroid's superweapon and save their family.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E13 Princess Cookie Finn and Jake are called on to solve a Candy Kingdom hostage crisis when a rogue cookie takes over.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E38 TV Knight 2 Batman and Commissioner Gordon have a slumber party to watch TV.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E41 Cool Uncles The Titans take a trip to Wackadoodles, but Trigon makes Raven babysit her little brothers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E28 The Uncle Gumball and Darwin are desperate to meet Ocho's famous uncle.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E1 A Barb is Born On the third day of the world, Barb tries to save the ferns from being eaten by the spotted bears. But the bears are only getting hungrier and hungrier - will Barb be able to stop the ferns from going extinct?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Foam Party Jim finds out that the sardines have parties, and it looks like he is somehow not on the list. He tries to not take it personally, but it's hard to be both a captain and a friend.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E22 Having The Timeout Of Our Lives Owen forms a special bond with Duncan after having loads of fun with him during their timeouts.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Adventures of a Normal Man Pt. 1 Secret alien Clark Kent and his best friend Jimmy Olsen start their internship at The Daily Planet and meet fellow intern Lois Lane - who ropes them into investigating stolen military robots threatening Metropolis!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Snakebit Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe - The Fangpyres - to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 School Learn to spell and write the word School. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wonderblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 The Breakfast Bears The Three Bears can't make their breakfast in the right order because they all want to go first! Go, Stop and The Breakfast Crew help them figure things out.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 Pick a Partner The Colourblocks enjoy a dance, but which colours make the best partners. Learn about similar and complimentary colours with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E17 Back in the Box! The Numberblocks have fun counting as they tidy up after games, but One finds it hard to keep track of everything. The friends use tally marks to fix their problem!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E21 Quest for Mr. Furmore Mr. More comes to the Super Readers for help solving the mystery of his missing cat!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 Umbrella Maddie heads to an umbrella factory to see how umbrellas are made using waterproof material.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E17 Bird Paradise Millie, Maeve and Pia love birds. But what about the humble Ibis, or Bin Chicken? Millie loves them! They create a sanctuary for Ibises and other native birds and watch them enjoy their brand new Bird Paradise.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E3 Heart Dr Chris and Dr Xand get to grips with the heart and show how to build a pumping heart model in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Science Max: Experiments at Large
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E12 Balance How can you balance a potato on a stick and can Phil balance on a tightrope using the same science? What's better for balance, staying put or using something that spins? Phil designs a gyroscopic stabilization backpack.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Physics House
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Why Does My Toast Land Buttered Side Down? Why is it that toast usually seems to land buttered-side down? Is it the weight of the butter? Or are there other forces at work? Join Yanick in the Physics House and get to the physics behind your ruined breakfast.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Bread It's an early rise for Dr Karl as he starts the day at the Goodman Fielder bakery in Burleigh Heads where they bake 100,000 loaves of bread every day.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E5 Fire Engine, Shepherd's Hut And Telescope A couple turn an old fire engine into a bar, to raise money for charity. Max builds a shepherds Hut from scratch, including the nuts and bolts! George visits an extraordinary home in Chile and Will builds a telescope.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E5 Memory Lee ruins Lucy's evening, joining her on the sofa to interrupt her favourite TV show by talking loudly over the dialogue. But when Lee suddenly can't remember the name of the lead actor, he thinks he may have dementia.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Spooks returns with MI5's crack team of spies taking on a terrorist group after a bomb explosion in London.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Building Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Keith and Kate have returned to the Scottish seaside town of Dunoon, where her dad grew up and she holidayed annually. But restoring the grand Victorian house they bought comes with costly surprises.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER

ABCMESydney.au.title: Like A Version - triple j
ABCMESydney.au.description: E18 Ethel Cain Ethel Cain covers Drive-By Truckers' 'Angels and Fuselage' for Like A Version.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E11 Film Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features Alan Davies, John Sessions, Emma Thompson and David Mitchell.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E4 Episode 4 Jack Carroll, Bridget Christie, Gabby Logan, and Big Zuu join host Rob Brydon and team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell to sort out the fact from the fiction.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E23 Thermite Vs. Ice Adam and Jamie put a classic YouTube myth to the test in 'Thermite v. Ice'. The result is one of the most dangerous outcomes they've ever had.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Dorking Phil's latest secret mission takes him to Dorking, where he finds a period property that's charming on the outside and a little bit alarming on the inside.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E6 Circus Wagon, Tree Hotel And Camping Pod Paul is battling Muscular Dystrophy to save a Victorian Circus Wagon, a grain store is re-imagined as a festival bar and George discovers a hotel that is disguised as a tree and a camping pod that looks like a giant conker.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E26 Episode 26 Yolanda Brown, Rev Kate Bottley, Joel Dommett and John Thomson test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E5 Zoe Coombs Marr, Rhonda Burchmore, Zion Garcia & Brett Blake Discussing the importance of The Wiggles in Australian cinema are both kinds of guests, Country (Zoe Coombs Marr) and Western (Rhonda Burchmore, Zion Garcia, Brett Blake). Robert Forster performs one of Alan's favourites.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E12 Vices and Virtues Join Sandi Toksvig for a QI look at Vices and Virtues with Eshaan Akbar, Jo Brand, Rhys James, and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E11 Unseen Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return with an episode of previously unseen material from the series.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E13 The Eyes Have It Featured magicians include Michael Pharoah, Xulio Merino, Topas and Toby Rudolph.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E9 Jeff Davis Aisha Tyler hosts another laughter-filled episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Jeff Davis.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E10 The Adventure of the Ersatz Sobekneferu Sherlock and his father, Morland Holmes, attempt to repair their strained relationship upon learning of a death within their family.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E13 Fortune's Fools Mark's success with prospective ER interns leads to an offer of a tenured teaching position. The hospital suspends Carol after she admits her fatal mistake to a newspaper reporter. Carter decides to transfer to Hicks' team.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E5 Memory Lee ruins Lucy's evening, joining her on the sofa to interrupt her favourite TV show by talking loudly over the dialogue. But when Lee suddenly can't remember the name of the lead actor, he thinks he may have dementia.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Rage: Guest Programmer ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E313 rage Guest Programmer: Party Dozen Sydney noise-rock duo Party Dozen bring their trademark experimental punk attitude to the couch, lining up a guest program from artists like Death Grips to Fugazi, L7, Viagra Boys and.The Blues Brothers?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E1 Spooks returns with MI5's crack team of spies taking on a terrorist group after a bomb explosion in London.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Dorking Phil's latest secret mission takes him to Dorking, where he finds a period property that's charming on the outside and a little bit alarming on the inside.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E1 Wales, Whales and Wails Join Sandi Toksvig for a new season of QI as she considers Wales, Whales, and Wails with Elis James, Griff Rhys Jones, Kiri Pritchard-McLean and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Queen of Oz
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 There's A New Queen In Town Georgie arrives in Australia, kicking and screaming with her new staff.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ABC News Update
ABCMESydney.au.description: E223 Tuesday 10 November 2026 The headlines from ABC News, updating you on the day's top stories from across Australia and around the world.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E11 Film Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features Alan Davies, John Sessions, Emma Thompson and David Mitchell.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E9 The Other Tarts Finn and Jake volunteer for a dangerous assignment: currying rare tarts for a meeting of Ooo royalty.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 Unica The Bears join forces with Unica, the ultimate forest protector.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E40 Forest Pirates While the Titans are at Super Hero Summer Camp for the week, they may need to add another teammate to win the big canoe race.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E2 Aliver The Girls compete for the title of World's Greatest Superheroes!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E13 Captain Hardrock Juleka's mother gets akumatized into Captain Hardrock. Steering an impregnable ship and armed with a pirate sword, she wants to blast her music across Paris. Prepare to board, mateys Ladybug and Cat Noir!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E7 The Debate Felicity and Darrell's debate 'The Third should have the same freedoms as the Sixth' becomes personal. Gwen's attempt at Matronly duty ends in chaos.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 K-Flop After her embarrassing fall in dance class goes viral, Hannah becomes known as #KFLOP. Deciding to face the heat like a dumpling, Hannah faces her fears, performs in front of her peers, and completes her day as a trainee.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 The Grandparents Day After last year's Grandparent's Day was a disaster, Mrs Gonsha is determined to make this year's celebration a great success. She has asked Battie's grandfather, a renowned inventor, to be the guest of honour.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E27 A Three Team Scheme! Ash and the others meet up with Professor Birch for a day of exploration and end up in the middle of a villainous confrontation!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E1 Aftermath The Maltos go on a search for the Embershards. When a Decepticon creates a new foe from a broken shard, the Malto's realize life in Witwicky is about to be chaotic.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E14 Card Wars Finn and Jake embark on an epic game of Card Quest.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E39 The Academy Robin creates the Teen Titans Awards!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E42 Butter Wall When Beast Boy declares the Earth is a pancake, the Titans set sail to find out.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E29 The Weirdo When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird. They observe her behaviour and decide that the only thing they have to change is absolutely everything.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E2 Hot Milk and Careless Whispers Barb tries to soothe the spotted bears with a dreamy invention, but soon finds herself outnumbered. Will Barb be able to even the playing field - or will she become the bears' next snack?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Bianca's Crazy Day Jim thinks Bianca is great with Roy, but she slacks off and spends time making valuable pompons. When Roy is kidnapped, Bianca must pay the ransom with her precious pompoms before Jim finds out!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E23 Hic Hic Hooray Bridgette gets the hiccups and becomes desperate to get rid of them.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Adventures of a Normal Man Pt. 2 Clark returns to the Kent farm with questions about where he's from - and who he wants to be. Meanwhile, Lois and Jimmy track down the mercenary Livewire. and encounter \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Never Trust a Snake After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor - the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Learn A Word ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 Boy Learn to spell and write the word Boy. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wonderblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E9 Moo! Cluck! Baa! Cow, Sheep and Secret Agent Chicken take part in a marvellous musical contest, with the help of Go and Stop as hosts.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 Black and White Black and White arrive in Colourland. Learn about two colours very different from the other Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E18 Five's Fruit Festival Five is having a fruit festival, but isn't sure how much fruit she'll need. Luckily Four finds a solution to her delivery needs.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E22 The Great Dino Dilemma! A rascally Lettersaur is loose in Reader Valley!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E2 Car Wash Maddie takes a car through an automatic car wash to find out how the computer uses sensors to tell the robotic carwash how to wash the car.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E18 Weaving Stories In Kakadu, Traditional Owners welcome Clarence and invite him to join them as they weave pandanus. They carefully harvest the leaves, then they get busy dyeing, drying, and finally weaving them into beautiful creations.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E4 Spots Dr Chris and Dr Xand take a look at spots and reveal how to make edible spot cakes in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BTN ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E32 Episode 32 Amelia Moseley takes a look at some of the major news stories of the week and explains the issues and events for school aged Australians.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Deadly Dinosaurs with Steve Backshall
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E7 Super Senses Steve's on a mission to find dinosaurs that are a little special.fearsome killers, with incredible abilities! His quest sees him race in the dark like a troodon and track prey from miles away like the daspletosaurus.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E199 Episode 199 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E6 Circus Wagon, Tree Hotel And Camping Pod Paul is battling Muscular Dystrophy to save a Victorian Circus Wagon, a grain store is re-imagined as a festival bar and George discovers a hotel that is disguised as a tree and a camping pod that looks like a giant conker.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E6 Whodunnit? Unable to convince Lucy that he didn't smash her precious heirloom, a blue and white antique vase that belonged to her grandmother, Lee summons the family to an emergency meeting to clear his name and flush out the culprit.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E2 MI5 is under pressure to find another bomb and its maker in time to save a hospital from being destroyed.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E10 The Adventure of the Ersatz Sobekneferu Sherlock and his father, Morland Holmes, attempt to repair their strained relationship upon learning of a death within their family.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E13 Fortune's Fools Mark's success with prospective ER interns leads to an offer of a tenured teaching position. The hospital suspends Carol after she admits her fatal mistake to a newspaper reporter. Carter decides to transfer to Hicks' team.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E24 Bring the Pain Louis' brother visits to share big news with the family. Eddie tries to find creative ways to watch the latest Chris Rock age-inappropriate stand-up comedy special, despite his parents' and brothers' disapproval. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E1 Gardens Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features Alan Davies, Dara O'Briain, Rob Brydon and David Mitchell.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S16 E1 Episode 1 Celebrity guests Bez, Motsi Mabuse, Shazia Mirza and Steve Pemberton reveal extraordinary stories about themselves, but are they telling the truth or making it all up?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E24 Bullet Fired Vs. Bullet Dropped Adam and Jamie use gravity to test whether a bullet dropped from a height can catch up with one fired from a gun; experimenting to see whether it's possible to knock someone's socks off.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E7 Riccall In the north Yorkshire village of Riccall, Phil Spencer meets Lawrence and Catherine Bendelow, who are struggling to sell a house they've been renting out to tenants for four years.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E7 Mini Hgv Caravan And Railway Carriage Chris and Jodie transform a camper into a mini HGV-caravan, a couple revamps a railway carriage into a rustic retreat, and George and Will learn to photograph with a beer can.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E22 The Keeper of Traken: Part 2 As Melkur begins to return to life, it manipulates Kassia into doing its bidding. The Doctor and Adric are held responsible for the evil that has come to Traken.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E23 The Keeper of Traken: Part 3 The Keeper nears the end of his life and Melkur is poised to take control of the all powerful source manipulator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E24 The Keeper of Traken: Part 4 Melkur has become the new Keeper of Traken and begins to access the source manipulator. As the Doctor takes steps to defeat it, he discovers the frightening truth about his enemy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E25 Logopolis: Part 1 Deciding to repair the TARDIS’s chameleon circuit, the Doctor goes to Earth to find a real police box. But an old enemy is one step ahead of him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E26 Logopolis: Part 2 The Doctor travels to the planet Logopolis in the TARDIS where a series of fateful events are set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E27 Logopolis: Part 3 The Master is loose on Logopolis and is determined to learn the planet’s secret, but there is more at stake than he realises.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E28 Logopolis: Part 4 With the fate of the entire universe hanging in the balance, the Doctor and the Master are forced to collaborate and return to Earth to carry out their plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E1 Castrovalva: Part 1 The Doctor tries to recuperate within the Zero Room, leaving Nyssa, Adric and Tegan to face the Master. Then Adric is taken and the TARDIS plunges towards Event One.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E2 Castrovalva: Part 2 The Zero Room is gone, and the Doctor’s regeneration is unstable. To help him, Tegan locates the tranquil world of Castrovalva and the TARDIS heads there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E3 Castrovalva: Part 3 Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help the Doctor identify the problem. And the Master is taunting Adric, caught in his web of power.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E4 Castrovalva: Part 4 As recursive occlusion threatens to destroy everything and everyone in Castrovalva, the Master’s space/time trap is revealed, with Adric at its heart.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E5 Four to Doomsday: Part 1 The arrival of the TARDIS is observed by three Urbankans via their manopticon devices. Intrigued, they begin dividing the Doctor’s friends, and disguising themselves as humans.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E6 Four to Doomsday: Part 2 As the Doctor meets the representatives of humanity aboard the Urbankan ship, a Grecian philosopher reveals a bizarre secret about Monarch and his methods.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E7 Four to Doomsday: Part 3 Panicking, Tegan accidentally pilots the TARDIS into space, while Lin Fitu betrays the Doctor and Bigon to Monarch, who demands they be beheaded as punishment.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E8 Four to Doomsday: Part 4 The Doctor takes a dangerous spacewalk to rescue Tegan, while Nyssa ansd Bigon keep the Urbankans distracted and Adric decides exactly whose side he is on.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E9 Kinda: Part 1 While Nyssa rests, Adric and the Doctor discover a military expedition on Deva Loka. Tegan falls asleep in the forest watched by the Kinda, but they cannot stop her dreams.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E10 Kinda: Part 2 Sanders meets Panna and Karuna, who leave a lasting impression on him, while the Dukkha does the same on Tegan. When Hindle’s breakdown begins, the Doctor and Todd are in danger.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E11 Kinda: Part 3 Aris now carries the mark of the Mara and has gained voice, so Panna shows the Doctor and Todd exactly what the past, present and future holds for Deva Loka.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E12 Kinda: Part 4 As the Mara finally breaks free of its dream dimension, the Kinda must do everything they can to contain it. Hindle’s need to destroy everything and everyone is unstoppable.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E13 The Visitation: Part 1 The TARDIS lands in 17th century England which is being stalked by a robotic death-like figure from behind a holographic wall. The locals seem to be under a strange mesmeric spell.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E14 The Visitation: Part 2 A Terileptil is living in Sir John's basement and is planning to wipe out mankind with plague rats. It decides to arrange for the Doctor and Richard Mace to be beheaded.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E15 The Visitation: Part 3 Nyssa and Adric and pursued by the Android, and they head to the safety of the TARDIS, while a mesmerised Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E16 The Visitation: Part 4 Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding. Forced to find a way to stop them, their soliton gas generator explodes, setting London ablaze.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E17 Black Orchid: Part 1 A murder is committed in Cranleigh Hall. The Cranleighs ask the Doctor to play cricket and then join them for a masked ball, enabling the killer to hide in plain sight.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E18 Black Orchid: Part 2 The Doctor stands accused, despite Lady Cranleigh knowing he is innocent. What is the secret she is protecting that allows her to let an honest man go to jail.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E19 Earthshock: Part 1 Deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E20 Earthshock: Part 2 With her crew slowly vanishing, Briggs assumes the Doctor to be the guilty party.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E21 Earthshock: Part 3 The Cybermen are released from their silos and are on the march.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E20 The Horns of Nimon: Part 4 On the dying world of Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon’s empty promises. The Doctor must find a way to shut down the power complex on Skonnos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E1 The Leisure Hive: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana visit the Leisure Hive on Argolis. The Argolin, survivors of a war, run the Hive as a tourist attraction but its future is jeopardised by a series of deaths.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E17 Black Orchid: Part 1 A murder is committed in Cranleigh Hall. The Cranleighs ask the Doctor to play cricket and then join them for a masked ball, enabling the killer to hide in plain sight.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E18 Black Orchid: Part 2 The Doctor stands accused, despite Lady Cranleigh knowing he is innocent. What is the secret she is protecting that allows her to let an honest man go to jail.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E19 Earthshock: Part 1 Deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E20 Earthshock: Part 2 With her crew slowly vanishing, Briggs assumes the Doctor to be the guilty party.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E21 Earthshock: Part 3 The Cybermen are released from their silos and are on the march.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E22 Earthshock: Part 4 The Doctor realises the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E23 Time-Flight: Part 1 When a Speedbird Concorde disappears back through a crack in time, the Doctor takes another Concorde to follow its trail, unaware that a mysterious conjuror, Kalid, waits for him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E24 Time-Flight: Part 2 After an encounter with the Plasmatons, Nyssa is possessed by strange aliens while the Doctor, joined by Professor Hayter investigates Kalid’s inner sanctum.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E25 Time-Flight: Part 3 From within their sarcophagus, the gestalt Xeraphin are communicating through Nyssa, but their psychic energy is so powerful, it may destroy her body completely.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E26 Time-Flight: Part 4 The Master’s TARDIS is repaired and the Doctor must follow him back to 20th century Heathrow, once he has rescued all the passengers and crew from both Concordes.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E1 Arc of Infinity: Part 1 On Gallifrey the Doctor has been chosen, during a clandestine meeting, to be used to perpetrate a terrible act. Unaware, the Doctor and Nyssa trace something odd to Amsterdam.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E2 Arc of Infinity: Part 2 Commander Maxil doesn’t believe the Doctor is innocent and reckons the easiest way to stop the evil being reborn on Gallifrey would be to kill him before the bonding can occur.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E3 Arc of Infinity: Part 3 President Borusa thinks the creature has been defeated but within the Matrix, the Doctor unmasks Omega and realises the threat to the matter universe is far from over.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E4 Arc of Infinity: Part 4 Omega has been reborn in Amsterdam in the Doctor's form, but the transference hasn’t worked. The Doctor pursues him through the city, aware Omega is now a walking anti-matter bomb.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E5 Snakedance: Part 1 The Mara is returning home, to the planet Manussa, five hundred years after being exiled. And it is using Tegan's subconscious to get there in the TARDIS.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E6 Snakedance: Part 2 As Tegan tries to rid her mind of the Mara forever, the Doctor learns about the Little Mind’s Eye crystal, while coping with the local politics of the Federator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E7 Snakedance: Part 3 As Tegan and Lon combine to give the Mara access back to reality, the Doctor locates the Great Mind’s Eye crystal but realises it is instrumental in the Mara's plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E8 Snakedance: Part 4 The Doctor and the original snakedancer Dojeen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E9 Mawdryn Undead: Part 1 Caught in a warp ellipse, the TARDIS is drawn to a huge spacecraft orbiting Earth whereupon the Doctor is separated in space and time from Nyssa and Tegan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Justine has big plans for a mountaintop picnic-but the Norwegian weather has other ideas. She takes shelter in a mountain hut instead, where she puts together a beautiful spread of open sandwiches.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Kylie Kwong and Kevin La cook and dine with the family chefs from Sun Ming Parramatta, Tang Bou and Hangang as well as dropping by Kevin's Dad's much loved grocery store in Bonnyrigg.
