SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Curd's The Word Bean curd, aka tofu, is the most common meat-sub for the veg-heads out there. But there's nothing common about Mary's new takes on tofu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E1 What's For Dinner? Every culture has their way of asking, 'What's for Dinner?' Lidia inspires shows some of her easy favourites - a flavourful arborio rice, antipasto rice salad, sauteed chicken, and mushroom gratinate.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Washed Rind Cheeses Of France There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Wine Country To start the wine focused chapter of this Food Trail, Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Chiavari A former medieval town, Chiavari invites visitors to slow down, wander, and connect with its people.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Kiruna, Sweden Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, this does not deter the locals from being outside for sport and food preparation.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E9 Robbie Mills: Baked Marinated Magpie Goose, Blachan, Braised Kangaroo Steaks With Asparagus Mushroom In this episode, Robbie Mills shares two of his sovereign foods with us: Magpie Goose and Kangaroo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E18 Rubbish Fish Cape Jervis fisherman, Alan Robertson supplies our Cook and Chef with Gummy shark and Eagle Ray, the catch you might have once thrown back.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E32 Episode 32 Laura enjoys the sunshine in the Adelaide Hills, cooking a Ricotta, Tomato and Pistachio Galette. David Mann and Charlie Carrington pimp up camp cuisine with a Thai Beef Salad cooked on the barbecue.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E2 Between The Buns S'mac Dogs Rachael kicks off summer with a fun and indulgent meal that will get everyone running to the table.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E1 Episode 1 Dive into a fresh selection of flavourful ingredients, starting with one of Italy's staples- prosciutto.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Strait To The Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Npa Homecoming Aaron returns home to his old stomping ground, the Northern Peninsula Area at the tip of Cape York.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E27 Episode 27 If you're looking for something to go with a cup of tea in the afternoon, you can't go past Laura's first recipe, Florentine Cookies. Catherine Velisha assembles a Halloumi Greek Salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Episode 7 Featuring Dilruk Jayasinha, Gary prepares an ube iced latte, a rich beef rendang, Malay achar vegetable pickle, and spicy slow cooked lamb shoulder with harissa.

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxm.us.description: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

fxm.us.title: The Empty Man
fxm.us.description: A series of mysterious disappearances in a small Midwestern town may be linked to a supernatural entity. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
fxm.us.description: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Soup to Nuts
fxm.us.description: Two guys and a girl run into Mexican rebels and lots of fires. (Comedy) - 1930

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: The Black Rose
fxm.us.description: Following the 13th-century death of his nobleman father, Walter of Gurnie (Tyrone Power) and his confidant, Tristram (Jack Hawkins), join a caravan led by the North African Bayan (Orson Welles) en route to China. Along the way, the beautiful Maryam (Cecile Aubry), known as the Black Rose, begs Walter to take her to England with him. When the warlord Bayan reveals his intention to invade and subjugate China's advanced society, the trio attempt their escape back to England. (Adventure) - 1950

fxm.us.title: All About Eve
fxm.us.description: Backstage story revolving around aspiring actress Eve Harrington. Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo. (Drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: My Friend Flicka
fxm.us.description: Ken McLaughlin (Roddy McDowall) is a precocious 10-year-old who lives with his family on a remote Wyoming ranch. When Ken returns home from school with failing grades, his father, Rob (Preston Foster), blames the boy's lack of personal responsibility. At the suggestion of his wife, Nell (Rita Johnson), Rob allows Ken to choose a single colt from the herd to raise as his own. Much to his father's dismay, Ken chooses a fiery mustang filly -- but the two soon become fast friends. (Children, Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Curly Top
fxm.us.description: Charming, headstrong young Elizabeth Blair (Shirley Temple) lives at the Lakeside Orphanage where her sister, Mary (Rochelle Hudson), works in the kitchen. Mary writes songs that Elizabeth sings. The child's performance and her spirit impress a young, wealthy trustee, Edward Morgan (John Boles), who poses as a lawyer with an offer of adoption for Elizabeth, but she won't leave without her sister. Edward decides to bring them both to his mansion, and soon begins to fall in love with Mary. (Musical) - 1935

fxm.us.title: A Journal for Jordan
fxm.us.description: Deployed to Iraq, First Sgt. Charles Monroe King starts to keep a journal of love and advice for his infant son. Back at home, Dana Canedy, a senior editor for The New York Times, revisits the story of her unlikely, life-altering relationship with King and his enduring devotion to his beloved family. 5starmax.us.description: A detective (Chazz Palminteri) questions a con man about his relationships with assorted criminals (Stephen Baldwin, Gabriel Byrne) and their link to a ship explosion. - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Walkabout
5starmax.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Hop
5starmax.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Holla
5starmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Horror) - 2006

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Blood Simple
5starmax.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
5starmax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

5starmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
5starmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

His right leg was amputated below the knee after a climbing accident, but he continued in his sport. Highway is assigned to train a group of undisciplined recruits including Cpl. Stitch Jones (Mario Van Peebles), a slick hustler who has previously encountered Highway. bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Fashion Rachel celebrates the quirkiness and individuality of London fashion in her kitchen, proving it's more about creativity than the price tag when it comes to getting your food looking and tasting good.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Crowd Pleasers Rachel makes some simple colorful canapés that are perfect for a party and creates a sophisticated jelly for grown-ups.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Nostalgia London makes Rachel feel nostalgic about her childhood, so she visits an ice-cream lab in North London and makes a firm family favorite - Strudel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Fast Food Rachel explores London's fast food scene, and whips up berry tartlets with cream cheese frosting and cauliflower cheeseburgers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Lazy Days Rachel prepares her favourite food for the perfect lazy day, cycles along a canal, visits her friend Tom's urban garden, and whips up a shepherdless pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 East Meets West Rachel celebrates London's love with the East as she makes sticky chicken with Malaysian salad and soft steamed buns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Traditional Values Rachel celebrates Londoners' love of tradition as she puts her own twist on the traditional fry-up and makes a simple one-tray roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On The Move Rachel joins an unusual supper club on an old tube carriage and makes sausage and mash for taxi drivers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 DIY Rachel visits a basement Norwegian style salmon smokehouse and a shop where the shelves are stocked with preserves made on a hob at home.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 The Pleasure's All Mine Rachel goes for a decadent champagne afternoon tea in Mayfair and makes some finger-licking ribs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rachel explores Melbourne's Chinatown, tastes some of the cities infamous coffee and checks out the new type of restaurant taking over Australia's food-loving capital.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rachel pays a visit to a century-old milk bar and a bar serving up some twists on Aussie classics before meeting up with Kate Gibbs, the granddaughter of legendary Aussie cook Margaret Fulton.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rachel explores some of the city's outer edges, where she discovers authentic and tasty croissants, before meeting up with seasonal cooking advocate Matt Wilkinson.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On her last few days in Melbourne, Rachel takes a look at the city's current and future food trends and throws a barbecue party for the foodies she has met during her time in Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nisha cooks oxtail and shin curry, spiced barbecued prawns and banana pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Nisha cooks some Malaysian mussels and ginger biscuit lamb raan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Nisha cooks meatball curry and tandoori chops with turmeric chips.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Nisha cooks egg and cauliflower curry and some Hungarian plum dumplings.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: Murphy's Romance

When Danny meets cute Debbie (Demi Moore) at a bar the friends frequent in Chicago's luxurious Gold Coast, the two start a sexually charged courtship that leaves jangled nerves and questioned motives all around. dateline.us.description: Two decades after a woman falls to her death, police reopen the case and arrest her husband.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Someone Was Watching
dateline.us.description: A mother, who seemed to be happily married, was found dead in her backyard spa.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Blue Blanket Mystery

fifthgear.us.description: S09 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson is the only British journalist invited to test drive Ferrari's new race car, the F430 Challenge; Tom Ford takes an exclusive one-off look into the secret world of the Maybach.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife. He is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt warden, the facility holds brutal fights between inmates. - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: A former Special Forces soldier (Sean Penn) who has PTSD tries to reconnect with his longtime lover, but must first find out who wants him dead... and why. - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Final Stand
filmriseaction.us.description: The story of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow during WWII, where the cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools receive orders to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line. - 2020

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover operative (Jean-Claude Van Damme) battles terrorists after they seize a train containing biological weapons. - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: While staying at a clinic for therapy, an FBI agent (Sylvester Stallone) searches for a serial killer who is murdering the staff and patients. - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: A former government assassin is forced out of hiding when his deadly protégé, known as Banshee, discovers there is a bounty on his life. To survive, they must fight off the CIA-backed killers coming for them. - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Direct Contact
filmriseaction.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. - 2009

filmriseaction.us.title: Abduction
filmriseaction.us.description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures. (Action) - 2019

filmriseaction.us.title: Cover-Up
filmriseaction.us.description: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv. (Action) - 1991

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. (Comedy, Crime drama, Action) - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist. (Historical drama) - 1995

filmriseaction.us.title: Guns of Redemption
filmriseaction.us.description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel. (Western, Action) - 2025

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. (Western) - 2023

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Sheriff

When Jason McCullough (James Garner), a clever and supremely laid-back gunslinger, wanders into town, he becomes the de facto lawman, aided by local eccentric Jake (Jack Elam). justicecentral.us.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
justicecentral.us.description: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives. (Reality, Law) - 2016-09-12

retroplex.us.description: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Check Your Guns
retroplex.us.description: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad). (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: West of the Divide
retroplex.us.description: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Bells of Coronado
retroplex.us.description: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers. (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
retroplex.us.description: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: In Old Amarillo
retroplex.us.description: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought. (Western) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: The Lucky Texan
retroplex.us.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday
retroplex.us.description: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight. (Special, Performing arts) - 2007-01-30

retroplex.us.title: Oath of Vengeance
retroplex.us.description: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
retroplex.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel (William Post Jr.) from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte (Kaaren Verne), to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him. (Mystery) - 1942

retroplex.us.title: Dressed to Kill
retroplex.us.description: Holmes and Watson hunt for three music boxes containing directions to the whereabouts of six valuable engraving plates stolen from the Bank of England. They find themselves in competition with professional thieves also out to find the clues, which were hidden by a spiteful jailbird before the music boxes went up for auction. (Mystery) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Woman in Green
retroplex.us.description: When a number of attractive women are found dead and with fingers missing, Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) investigate. Though evidence points to a psychotic killer, Holmes begins to believe that there's more to the case than initially meets the eye, a notion that leads him to uncover the involvement of his archenemy, Professor Moriarty (Henry Daniell). Who is working with Moriarty on such a dastardly plot, and what are their motives? (Mystery) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Vengeance Valley
retroplex.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. (Western) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Boss

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen sich Live-Übertragungen von Konzerten im Fernsehen an, beispielsweise das Neujahrskonzert. Die Dokumentation zeigt, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, einem breiten Publikum klassische Musik näherzubringen. - 2012

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Barockwerke von Bach, Muffat und Rameau
classica.us.description: Paul Goodwin dirigiert das Conjunto Barroco. Auf dem Programm steht unter anderem Muffats Sonata Nr. 5 in G-Dur. Diese Aufführung wurde am 8. Februar 2024 im Auditorio Sony der Reina Sofía Musikschule in Madrid aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. - 2019

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 2
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte.

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt.

classica.us.title: Bruckner - 7. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: In einem Konzert von 2019 im Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven leitet Dirigent Hartmut Haenchen das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland. Das Konzert dreht sich ganz um Anton Bruckners 7. Sinfonie.

classica.us.title: Galaxymphony II - Galaxymphony Strikes Back
classica.us.description: Jakob Stegelmann und das DR Sinfonieorchester feiern John Williams und ikonische Filmmusik.

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

classica.us.title: Berlioz : Symphonie fantastique, op. 14
classica.us.description: Das Armenische Nationalphilharmonische Orchester führt Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14 auf. Dieses ist unter der Leitung von Dirigent Eduard Topchjan. Komponiert wurde das Stück von Hector Berlioz im Jahr 1830.

classica.us.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
classica.us.description: Die Musikerin Barbara Hannigan gewann den Grammy für das beste klassische Solo-Vokalalbum 2018 und wurde 2022 als Künstlerin des Jahres ausgezeichnet. Im Herbst 2023 gab sie ihr lang erwartetes Dirigentendebüt mit dem Cleveland Orchestra.

classica.us.title: Bach - 4. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 4 in G-Dur.

classica.us.title: Bach - 2. Partita für Violin (BWV 1004)
classica.us.description: Die deutsche Geigerin Isabelle Faust spielt dieses Mal zwei beeindruckende Solowerke für die Violine. So spielt sie von Johann Sebastian Bach die Partita Nummer 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 sowie auch die Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005.

classica.us.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
classica.us.description: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können. In diesem Dokumentarfilm gehen die Filmemacher unter anderem dem Phänomen der Kastraten auf den Grund. - 2012

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin.

classica.us.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
classica.us.description: Riccardo Frizza dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einer Aufführung der tragischen Oper "Rigoletto" von Giuseppe Verdi. Diese Aufführung wurde 2021 im Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florenz aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Galaxmphony - Die finale Odyssee
classica.us.description: Das DR Symphonieorchester sprengt die Schallmauer und entführt Sie in ferne Galaxien - an einen Ort, der zwischen Realität und Fantasie liegt, mit Soundtracks von Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune und vielen anderen.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo. (Music) - 2000-04-23

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in C-Dur, op. 21
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 1. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in C-Dur Op. 21, und diese zeigt die Loyalität Beethovens zu den Modellen von Joseph Haydn und Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-04-02

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
classica.us.description: In der Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz die Humoreske in B-Dur, Op. 20. Schumann komponierte das Werk im Jahr 1839 und widmete es Julie von Webenau. Der Titel des Werks bezieht sich auf die ältere Bedeutung von Humor als emotionaler Zustand. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-12-19

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

moviesphere.us.title: Conan the Barbarian
moviesphere.us.description: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2011-08-19

moviesphere.us.title: Gods of Egypt
moviesphere.us.description: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2016-02-25

moviesphere.us.description: After surviving an incredible plunge to near-certain death, Chev Chelios is abducted by Chinese mobsters. Chev escapes from his captors, reunites with his lover, Eve, and sets out on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to get his real heart back. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2009-04-15

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 A Tuscan Escape We meet Alex who is on the lookout for his forever home. Viviana is taking him through some of the most beautiful properties in Santa Barbara, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 Hollywood Hills Mega Mansions We meet Johnny and Jenny who are searching for a luxury home. Viviana is taking them through some of the most beautiful mega mansions in Los Angeles, California. They need a house with the perfect entertaining space.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Tranquil Park City Escape Savanah is looking for a home in Park City, Utah to escape from her LA lifestyle. As a filmmaker, she's looking for a home that'll inspire her creativity, as well as accommodate industry events during local film festivals.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E06 Life-Sized Sister Playhouse Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Mid-Century Poolside Retreat Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Fast Paced Roman Recipes
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Best of Salina's Land and Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Making Pizza in Naples
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Desperately Seeking Santa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man. (Cooking, Travel)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Benson Grist Mill

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Lost Souls Of The Berkeley
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew board a steam ferry from the 1800s to investigate escalating paranormal activity; the staff fears something dark has awakened on the historical vessel after lying dormant for months during the COVID-19 pandemic. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Injured in an Auto Accident? Call Big Auto
travel.us.description: After an accident, discover your options, avoid costly mistakes and learn how to connect with an attorney to review your case. (Paid Program)

travel.us.title: Capital Living

travel.us.title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
travel.us.description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen. (Paid Program, Health)

travel.us.title: 2026 Silver Eagle is here & it is a once-in-a-lifetime coin!
travel.us.description: Join your hosts Kevin Cash & Cory Cady as we discuss the 250th Anniversary of America with the official "America 250" logo on a Silver American Eagle label; we are locking in orders for this iconic release, but coins are limited! Don't miss out! (Paid Program)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Watch Your Step
travel.us.description: Russell discovers new sights and sounds deep in the backcountry of Northern California; Bryce talks with a witness who had an experience with a family of Bigfoot; Mireya reaches new heights in search of physical evidence of the elusive creature. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Smells Like Bigfoot
travel.us.description: In NorCal's backcountry, the team develops a clear plan of attack to lure Bigfoot out of hiding; Russell travels overnight, hoping to gather key evidence in their search; Mireya and Bryce conduct an investigation unlike any other. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - The Gathering Storm
travel.us.description: The team's investigations converge as Bryce, Mireya and Russell discover tree structures on different sides of the same mountain; as a storm approaches, Bryce prepares an AI-powered surveillance array that will help pinpoint Bigfoot's location. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Bigfoot's Doorstep
travel.us.description: Bryce, Mireya and Russell converge at the center of their NorCal hot zone as a catastrophic storm threatens the expedition; armed with AI technology, they're ready to meet the elusive cryptid before it's too late; Russell spies signs of Bigfoot. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Why Are They Here?
travel.us.description: Months after the Northern California expedition, Bryce, Mireya, and Russell head to Washington after a fresh lead points to a target zone where Bigfoot groups are congregating for an unknown reason; Survivalist Biko Wright joins the hunt. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Warning Signals
travel.us.description: South of a Bigfoot chokepoint in Washington, Russell follows a trail of warning signs into the backcountry; Mireya and Biko track what could be a curious Bigfoot; Bryce speaks with a witness, who wishes he never laid eyes on the cryptid creature. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Right on Track
travel.us.description: In the heart of The Fork, Russell is on the trail of a possible pair of Bigfoot; Mireya and Biko utilize cutting-edge tech to try and catch a base camp intruder as Bryce makes a startling find while reviewing footage. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Perilous Descent
travel.us.description: Deep in "The Fork," Russell rappels a 700-foot cliff to follow a heat signature; Mireya and Biko track signs outside their base camp; Bryce hears new information about strange vocalizations and discovers that someone has visited his command center. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Element of Surprise
travel.us.description: Mireya and Biko navigate rapids while tracking a possible hunting party; Bryce gains knowledge from fresh prints; Russell creates a trap for Bigfoot. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Line of Sight
travel.us.description: In Washington's backcountry, Mireya and Biko take cues from the land after finding a series of tree structures that lead them to a water source; Bryce gains insight into the mysterious print found at his cabin; Russell's bushcraft tripwire pays off. (Paranormal)
